A third-party I/O tool. A copy is in `bin/iotools-1.5`. No TRON build file builds it.
The script that starts cargo for the TRON build and lint commands. `CMakeLists.txt`, `GNUmakefile`, `lefthook.yml` and `rust/run-cargo-test-binary` call it.
The Git hook configuration of the repository. Its `pre-commit` section lists the commands that run before a commit, for example `rustfmt`.
The script that generates a Perfetto trace configuration from command-line options.
The Python tokenizer helper. It loads a Hugging Face tokenizer and encodes or decodes text.
`bin/rinzler` and `bin/runtron`. Each one is a Python wrapper that starts `gen/rinzler` or `gen/runtron`, directly or through Dice.

notes: Short version: 24 rows checked against the checkout at commit 7eddde7895. 15 rows changed, 9 rows stay as written, and no row is dropped. The largest correction is in PYTEST_CURRENT_TEST: the code accepts only three pytest command-line forms, and `a pytest command` was too broad. Checks that ran on this file: JSON validation, one row per input variable, no pipe character and no line break in any field (evidence quotes included), word limits (values 30, default 25, effect 35, notes 45), and every evidence quote equals the stripped source line at its site. Every name in read_by exists in the checkout. A git grep for each of the 24 names found no reader or setter that the rows miss. Row PWD: the code that reads PWD in the shell hook is flake.nix:557. That line holds pipe characters, so the evidence quotes the comment at flake.nix:555 instead. Conventions kept from the first draft: tron_use counts test files, so PYTEST_CURRENT_TEST and RUNNER_TEMP are 'reads and sets' although only tests set them. Rows of variables that TRON only sets or only removes have an empty default. RHOST, RUSER and RM stay in group build-tools. Facts measured outside the checkout on this host (bash 5.1.16, GNU Make 4.3): bash replaces an inherited PWD that does not name the current directory. GNU Make keeps an empty environment value for a '?=' variable (RUSER). An environment value replaces the built-in RM, and an empty one leaves the recipe without a command. Facts that come from the documentation of other software and that no line of the checkout states: the meaning of PYTHONCOERCECLOCALE=0, PYTHONUTF8=0, PYTHONNOUSERSITE=1, PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1, an empty RUSTC_WRAPPER or RUSTC_WORKSPACE_WRAPPER, and 'wrapProgram --set'. The meaning of PY_COLORS=0 is stated only in a comment (t/proxy/test_rzproxy.py:2602). PYTEST_CURRENT_TEST: bin/rinzler, bin/runtron and bin/slice call the check of bin/dice. They use their own copy only when bin/dice is missing or lacks the function. The copies ignore the override without a message and have no git checkout condition. The row has no room for this.

changes.was: Unset: GNU Make uses its built-in value `rm -f`.

changes.name: RUSTC
changes.was: When `IN_NIX_SHELL` is not empty, `rust/run-cargo` replaces any value with `$TRON_NIX_RUST_TOOLCHAIN/bin/rustc`, and then starts `$TRON_NIX_RUST_TOOLCHAIN/bin/cargo`. Otherwise it does not change the value.
changes.now: When `IN_NIX_SHELL` is not empty, `rust/run-cargo` replaces any value with `$TRON_NIX_RUST_TOOLCHAIN/bin/rustc`, and then starts `$TRON_NIX_RUST_TOOLCHAIN/bin/cargo`. Otherwise the value of the caller reaches cargo unchanged.
changes.why: Outside the Nix branch the script starts `cargo` with the inherited environment (rust/run-cargo:37-49). The file that `rust/rust-toolchain.sh` writes for that branch sets only `RUSTUP_HOME`, `CARGO_HOME` and `PATH` (rust/rust-toolchain.sh:138-141). The new sentence says what a caller can act on.

changes.now: `bin/ci/test-nix-rust-toolchain.sh` sets `/bin/false` and requires that `cargo build`, `cargo fmt --check` and `cargo doc --no-deps` through `rust/run-cargo` succeed. `bin/ci/test_install_nix_hooks.py` sets the path of a fake tool for a commit through the installed Git hook. `rust/run-cargo` also sets `CARGO_BUILD_RUSTC` to the same path.
